lines.1: 「So our job is to recruit new talent.」
lines.2: 「Normally, we would never become anyone's lapdogs, but...」
lines.4: 「So let's put some spirit into this search!」
lines.5: 「It's rare for all of us to agree this completely.」
lines.6: 「Nothing motivates people like dangling material rewards in front of them.」
lines.7: 「I'd feel lousy being the only one to bail. I'll help until track practice starts.」
lines.8: 「We just have to bring back a cute first-year, right? How should we approach this?」
lines.9: 「If that's the job, leave it to me.」
lines.10: I immediately had a bad feeling.
